note: Original Orbis factual synthesis; linked federal records and historic-site accounts, checked 14 October 2026. Points locate places approximately, not territorial extents. Modern national/state outlines are reference geography, never reconstructed historical borders. No archival images or source prose redistributed.

items.title: Delaware
items.text: Delaware ratified the Constitution in 1787. Its position as the first state reflects ratification order; the state already existed before that constitutional decision.

items.title: California / Sacramento
items.text: California became a state in 1850, after the Mexican cession of 1848. Admission brought representation in the federal union rather than a new international acquisition.

items.title: Alaska / Juneau
items.text: Alaska joined the union in January 1959. The gap from the 1867 purchase shows why an acquisition map and a statehood map answer different questions.

items.title: Hawaii / Honolulu
items.text: Hawaii became a state in August 1959. Its island geography places part of the union far beyond the contiguous mainland.
